pages.text: Lead an adult horse or donkey to the shafts. With a lead in hand, use any part of the shafts to hitch it. Its existing lead secures it; no extra lead is charged.$(br2)Single shafts need one animal. Both positions on double shafts must be occupied before driving.

Use the seat’s $(bold)visible upper surface$(reset) to board. The left seat drives a two-seat bench; the middle seat drives a three-seat bench.$(br2)$(k:forward) moves forward; $(k:back) brakes or reverses; $(k:left) and $(k:right) steer. $(k:sneak) dismounts.$(br2)Try an empty wagon first, then learn $(l:tm_wagon:cargo/loading)cargo handling$(/l).
